PROP-eip-7951-pre-inv-001.text: P256VERIFY precompile must never revert regardless of input (except out-of-gas).
PROP-eip-7951-pre-inv-001.assertion: forall input: p256verify(input) => (returns_result OR returns_empty) AND NOT reverts

PROP-eip-7951-pre-inv-002.text: P256VERIFY gas cost is fixed at 6900 regardless of input or execution path.

PROP-eip-7951-pre-pre-001.text: Signature scalars r and s must satisfy 0 < r < n and 0 < s < n before verification.
PROP-eip-7951-pre-pre-001.assertion: forall (h,r,s,qx,qy): verify(h,r,s,qx,qy) => 0 < r < SECP256R1_N AND 0 < s < SECP256R1_N

PROP-eip-7951-pre-pre-002.text: Public key coordinates qx, qy must satisfy 0 <= qx < p and 0 <= qy < p.
PROP-eip-7951-pre-pre-002.assertion: forall (qx,qy): point_valid(qx,qy) => 0 <= qx < SECP256R1_P AND 0 <= qy < SECP256R1_P

PROP-eip-7951-pre-pre-003.text: Public key (qx, qy) must lie on secp256r1 curve: qy^2 == qx^3 + a*qx + b (mod p).
PROP-eip-7951-pre-pre-003.assertion: forall (qx,qy): point_valid(qx,qy) => qy^2 mod p == (qx^3 + a*qx + b) mod p

PROP-eip-7951-pre-pre-004.text: Public key (qx, qy) must not be the point at infinity (0, 0).

PROP-eip-7951-pre-inv-005.text: R' point-at-infinity check is required; skipping it enables signature forgery (RIP-7212 fix).
PROP-eip-7951-pre-inv-005.assertion: forall (h,r,s,qx,qy): R' = u1*G + u2*Q => (R' == INF => return false)

PROP-eip-7951-pre-inv-006.text: Final comparison must use r' == r (mod n), not direct equality (RIP-7212 fix).
PROP-eip-7951-pre-inv-006.assertion: forall verify: compare(r', r) => r' mod n == r mod n

PROP-eip-7951-pre-inv-007.text: Modular inverse s^(-1) must be computed modulo subgroup order n, not field modulus p.
PROP-eip-7951-pre-inv-007.assertion: forall s: s_inv = mod_inverse(s, SECP256R1_N) AND NOT mod_inverse(s, SECP256R1_P)

PROP-eip-7951-pre-inv-008.text: Scalar multiplications and point addition must use secp256r1 curve parameters, not secp256k1.

PROP-eip-7951-pre-inv-010.text: Field bounds check must use field modulus p for coordinates, not subgroup order n.
PROP-eip-7951-pre-inv-010.assertion: forall (qx,qy): bounds_check(qx) uses SECP256R1_P AND bounds_check(qy) uses SECP256R1_P

PROP-eip-7951-pre-asm-001.text: Transaction callers can supply arbitrary input to P256VERIFY; all inputs must be validated.
PROP-eip-7951-pre-asm-001.assertion: forall caller, input: p256verify(input) => input_validation(input) executed before crypto_ops

PROP-eip-7951-pre-inv-012.text: Blob commitment count must not exceed get_blob_parameters(epoch).max_blobs_per_block.

PROP-eip-7951-pre-inv-013.text: Execution payload parent_hash must chain to state.latest_execution_payload_header.block_hash.

PROP-eip-7951-pre-inv-014.text: Execution payload prev_randao must match get_randao_mix(state, current_epoch).

PROP-eip-7951-pre-inv-015.text: Execution payload timestamp must equal compute_time_at_slot(state, state.slot).

PROP-eip-7951-pre-inv-016.text: BLOB_SCHEDULE entries must have unique epoch values to ensure deterministic parameter lookup.
PROP-eip-7951-pre-inv-016.assertion: forall i,j: i != j => BLOB_SCHEDULE[i].epoch != BLOB_SCHEDULE[j].epoch

PROP-eip-7951-pre-inv-017.text: All BLOB_SCHEDULE max_blobs_per_block values must not exceed MAX_BLOB_COMMITMENTS_PER_BLOCK.
PROP-eip-7951-pre-inv-017.assertion: forall entry in BLOB_SCHEDULE: entry.max_blobs_per_block <= MAX_BLOB_COMMITMENTS_PER_BLOCK

PROP-eip-7951-pre-inv-020.text: Fork digest must incorporate blob parameters via XOR; different blob configs produce different digests.
PROP-eip-7951-pre-inv-020.assertion: forall e1,e2: blob_params(e1) != blob_params(e2) => fork_digest(e1) != fork_digest(e2)

PROP-eip-7951-pre-inv-024.text: get_beacon_proposer_index must use pre-calculated proposer_lookahead, not on-demand computation.

PROP-eip-7951-pre-inv-026.text: All 15 epoch sub-processes must execute in strict sequential order; reordering is invalid.
PROP-eip-7951-pre-inv-026.assertion: forall epoch_transition: execution_order == [just, inact, rewards, registry, slash, eth1, deposits, consol, balance, slash_reset, randao, hist, part, sync, lookahead]

PROP-eip-7951-pre-inv-027.text: process_proposer_lookahead must be the final step in epoch processing (EIP-7917).

PROP-eip-7951-pre-post-002.text: Lookahead shift removes exactly SLOTS_PER_EPOCH entries from the front of the array.

PROP-eip-7951-pre-post-003.text: New proposers computed for epoch N+MIN_SEED_LOOKAHEAD+1 at epoch N boundary.
PROP-eip-7951-pre-post-003.assertion: forall epoch N: new_proposers == get_beacon_proposer_indices(state, N + MIN_SEED_LOOKAHEAD + 1)

PROP-eip-7951-pre-asm-003.text: Engine API is JWT-authenticated; verify_and_notify_new_payload requires valid JWT.

PROP-eip-7951-pre-asm-004.text: P2P peers are untrusted; all block fields must be fully validated before state mutation.
PROP-eip-7951-pre-asm-004.assertion: forall block from P2P: validate(block) executed before apply_state_transition(block)

PROP-eip-7951-pre-asm-005.text: Blob parameters in fork digest ensure nodes with different configs form separate networks.
PROP-eip-7951-pre-asm-005.assertion: forall node_a, node_b: blob_params(a) != blob_params(b) => network(a) != network(b)

PROP-eip-7951-pre-pre-005.text: Execution engine must validate and accept payload before CL caches the execution payload header.

PROP-eip-7951-pre-post-004.text: After processing execution payload, state.latest_execution_payload_header is updated to new header.

PROP-eip-7951-pre-inv-028.text: Proposer lookahead for epoch N+1 must be available at start of epoch N.
PROP-eip-7951-pre-inv-028.assertion: forall epoch N, slot in N+1: state.proposer_lookahead contains proposer for slot

PROP-eip-7951-pre-inv-029.text: State mutations from earlier epoch sub-processes must be visible to later sub-processes.
PROP-eip-7951-pre-inv-029.assertion: forall step_i, step_j: i < j => state_after(step_i) == state_input(step_j)

PROP-state1-inv-001.text: Total ether must be conserved across move_ether: sender debit equals recipient credit.
PROP-state1-inv-001.assertion: forall move_ether(s, from, to, amt): balance(s', from) == balance(s, from) - amt AND balance(s', to) == balance(s, to) + amt

PROP-state1-inv-002.text: move_ether must revert when sender balance is insufficient.
PROP-state1-inv-002.assertion: forall move_ether(s, from, to, amt): balance(s, from) < amt => revert(AssertionError)

PROP-state1-inv-003.text: Transaction gas must be >= max(intrinsic_gas, calldata_floor) per EIP-7623.
PROP-state1-inv-003.assertion: forall validate_tx(tx): tx.gas >= max(intrinsic_gas(tx), calldata_floor(tx)) OR raise InsufficientTransactionGasError

PROP-state1-inv-004.text: Transaction gas must not exceed TX_MAX_GAS_LIMIT (16,777,216) per EIP-7825.
PROP-state1-inv-004.assertion: forall validate_tx(tx): tx.gas <= 16777216 OR raise TransactionGasLimitExceededError

PROP-state1-pre-001.text: Signature r value must be in range (0, SECP256K1N) for valid sender recovery.
PROP-state1-pre-001.assertion: forall recover_sender(tx): 0 < tx.r < SECP256K1N OR raise InvalidSignatureError

PROP-state1-pre-002.text: Signature s value must satisfy low-s rule: 0 < s <= SECP256K1N/2.
PROP-state1-pre-002.assertion: forall recover_sender(tx): 0 < tx.s <= SECP256K1N / 2 OR raise InvalidSignatureError

PROP-state1-inv-005.text: Rollback must restore state to the exact snapshot captured by begin_transaction.
PROP-state1-inv-005.assertion: forall rollback(s): s._main_trie == snapshot_trie AND s._storage_tries == snapshot_storage

PROP-state1-inv-006.text: Transient storage must be restored to snapshot state on rollback.

PROP-state1-inv-007.text: begin_transaction must create deep copies of tries so in-flight mutations don't corrupt snapshots.
PROP-state1-inv-007.assertion: forall begin_tx(s): id(snapshot.main_trie) != id(s._main_trie) AND snapshot.main_trie == s._main_trie

PROP-state1-inv-008.text: commit_transaction clears created_accounts only when last snapshot is popped.
PROP-state1-inv-008.assertion: forall commit_tx(s): len(s._snapshots) == 0 => s.created_accounts == {} AND len(s._snapshots) > 0 => s.created_accounts unchanged

PROP-state1-pre-003.text: set_storage must assert account exists before writing storage.
PROP-state1-pre-003.assertion: forall set_storage(s, addr, k, v): trie_get(s._main_trie, addr) != None

PROP-state1-inv-009.text: Empty storage tries must be cleaned up after set_storage zeros all keys.
PROP-state1-inv-009.assertion: forall set_storage(s, addr, k, v): trie._data == {} => addr not in s._storage_tries

PROP-state1-inv-010.text: destroy_account must remove both the account and its storage trie.
PROP-state1-inv-010.assertion: forall destroy_account(s, addr): trie_get(s._main_trie, addr) == None AND addr not in s._storage_tries

PROP-state1-inv-011.text: modify_state must auto-destroy empty accounts (nonce=0, code=b'', balance=0).
PROP-state1-inv-011.assertion: forall modify_state(s, addr, f): account'.nonce==0 AND account'.code==b'' AND account'.balance==0 => destroy_account(s, addr)

PROP-state1-inv-012.text: Nonce must increment by exactly 1 per increment_nonce call.
PROP-state1-inv-012.assertion: forall increment_nonce(s, addr): nonce(s', addr) == nonce(s, addr) + 1

PROP-state1-inv-013.text: Transaction nonce must be less than U64.MAX_VALUE to prevent overflow.
PROP-state1-inv-013.assertion: forall validate_tx(tx): U256(tx.nonce) < U256(U64.MAX_VALUE) OR raise NonceOverflowError

PROP-state1-inv-014.text: Contract creation initcode must not exceed MAX_INIT_CODE_SIZE.
PROP-state1-inv-014.assertion: forall validate_tx(tx): tx.to == Bytes0 => len(tx.data) <= MAX_INIT_CODE_SIZE OR raise InitCodeTooLargeError

PROP-state1-pre-004.text: decode_transaction must reject unknown type prefixes with TransactionTypeError.
PROP-state1-pre-004.assertion: forall decode_tx(raw): raw[0] not in {1,2,3,4} AND not LegacyTransaction => raise TransactionTypeError
